title: ln-ashlar Declarative Attributes Schema Catalog
description: Machine-readable JSON schema catalog of all real data-ln-* attributes across ln-ashlar components for AI models.

element.note: Universal DOM helpers (fill, fillTemplate, renderList, buildDict, debug) consumed globally across components.

data-ln-field.description: Binds DOM textContent to a property key during fill() or fillTemplate() rendering.

data-ln-attr.description: Binds element attributes dynamically during fill() rendering (e.g. 'href:url,title:name').

data-ln-show.description: Evaluates boolean visibility condition during fill() rendering, showing/hiding element.

data-ln-class.description: Toggles CSS classes dynamically during fill() rendering (e.g. 'active:isActive,hidden:isPending').

data-ln-template.description: Declares template name on <template> elements for cloneTemplate() instantiation.

data-ln-value.description: Provides raw machine-readable data value for text elements (e.g. unformatted numbers or dates).

data-ln-fill-as.description: Aliases record field name to match different form input name during fill().

data-ln-fillable.description: Opt-in marker for elements allowed to receive auto-fill data.

data-ln-key.description: Identifies item key property for DOM element reuse in renderList().

data-ln-persist.description: Storage key for persisting state in LocalStorage/SessionStorage.

data-ln-debug.description: Enables verbose console logging for component lifecycle events.

element.note: Container for collapsible accordion panels. Recommended markup uses <ul> or <ol> with <li> children for each accordion item.
Can be attached to body, parent container, or form element.

data-ln-ajax.description: Boolean flag activating AJAX interception when present or empty. Set to 'false' to explicitly exclude a nested link or form from parent AJAX delegation.

element.note: Stateless REST API driver. Recommended as hidden <li> inside coordinator <ul> or <ol>.

data-ln-api-connector.description: Initializes API connector driver; optional value sets resource path directly.

data-ln-api-base-url.description: Base HTTP address of backend API endpoint.

data-ln-api-headers.description: JSON string of custom HTTP headers for requests.

data-ln-api-param-offset.description: URL query param key for pagination offset (default: 'offset').

data-ln-api-param-limit.description: URL query param key for page size limit (default: 'limit').

data-ln-api-param-search.description: URL query param key for search term (default: 'search').

data-ln-api-param-sort-field.description: URL query param key for sort field name (default: 'sort_field').

data-ln-api-param-sort-dir.description: URL query param key for sort direction (default: 'sort_dir').

element.note: Offline write queue child element under ln-data-coordinator.

data-ln-api-queue-online.description: Reflected state attribute set by JS indicating network/queue sync state.

element.note: Applies strictly to <textarea> elements for dynamic height expansion; JS enforces dom.tagName === 'TEXTAREA'.
Attached to forms or inputs for automated local storage draft saving.

data-ln-autosave.description: Initializes form draft auto-saving with given storage key.

data-ln-autosave-clear.description: Clears saved draft state when clicked.

data-ln-autosave-debounce-input.description: Debounce delay in ms for input autosave (default: 500).

data-ln-autosave-exclude.description: Excludes specific form input control from draft storage.

element.note: Responsive SVG line/area renderer bound to an ordered numeric dataset.

data-ln-chart.description: Component name and chart event identity.

data-ln-chart-source.description: Data-driven source name and coordinator fallback binding.

data-ln-chart-store.description: Local data-store name served by ln-data-coordinator.

data-ln-chart-x.description: Record field used as the ordered category label.

data-ln-chart-y.description: Record field containing the numeric series value.

data-ln-chart-type.description: SVG rendering mode; polygon aliases area.

data-ln-chart-sort.description: Optional query sort formatted as field:asc or field:desc.

data-ln-chart-padding.description: Inner padding measured in authored SVG viewBox units.

data-ln-chart-zero.description: Set false to opt out of the default zero-inclusive y domain.

data-ln-chart-plot.description: Authored SVG plotting surface; requires a valid viewBox.

data-ln-chart-area.description: Optional authored polygon receiving area points.

data-ln-chart-labels.description: Optional container populated from the {chartName}-label template.

data-ln-chart-empty.description: Authored empty-state element toggled when no valid values exist.

element.note: SVG circular progress indicator.

data-ln-circular-progress.description: Current numeric value for circular progress rendering.

data-ln-circular-progress-label.description: Accessible label or custom format string.

element.note: In-place two-step confirmation button for single low-impact actions.

data-ln-confirm.description: Confirmation prompt text displayed on first click.

data-ln-confirm-timeout.description: Timeout in ms before active confirmation resets to idle (default: 3000).

data-ln-confirm-idle.description: Original button text restored after timeout.

element.note: CouchDB database driver child element under ln-data-coordinator.

data-ln-couchdb-auth.description: Authentication mode or basic auth token.

data-ln-couchdb-headers.description: JSON string of HTTP headers for CouchDB requests.

element.note: Layer 2 data coordinator parent list (<ul data-ln-data-coordinator> or <ol>) enclosing store, connector, and queue <li> elements.

data-ln-data-coordinator.description: Initializes data coordinator and names entity namespace.

data-ln-data-coordinator-dict.description: Selector for hidden i18n error toast message dictionary.

data-ln-data-coordinator-stale.description: Stale cache duration threshold in seconds.

data-ln-data-coordinator-no-autosync.description: Disables automatic background polling and tab visibility sync.

data-ln-data-mapper.description: Key name of registered custom data transformation mapper function.

element.note: IndexedDB local store definition child inside coordinator.

data-ln-data-store.description: Initializes local IndexedDB store instance for given store name.

data-ln-data-store-indexes.description: Comma-separated list of IndexedDB index fields to create.

data-ln-data-store-stale.description: Store cache expiration threshold in seconds.

data-ln-data-store-search-fields.description: Fields to index for local client-side store search queries.

element.note: Date formatting component for <time datetime='...'> elements or form <input type='date'> fields.

data-ln-date.description: Date formatting preset style using Intl.DateTimeFormat.

data-ln-date-dict.description: BCP 47 language code for custom month/day fallback dictionary container.

data-ln-date-dict-key.description: Dictionary key type for date fallback translations.

data-ln-date-field.description: Record field key holding date string.

data-ln-date-label.description: Accessible aria-label prefix for rendered date.

element.note: Dropdown menu wrapper container (commonly a <div>, <li> inside a navbar <ul>, or <nav> container).
WYSIWYG rich text editor attached to <textarea>.
Automatic global helper running on document.body. Auto-decorates all cross-host <a> and <area> links with target='_blank', rel='noopener noreferrer', and screen-reader accessibility hints.

data-ln-external-link.description: Internal reflected state attribute set automatically by JS after processing a cross-host link.

element.note: Declarative DOM hydration component.

data-ln-fill-store.description: Data store name to fetch item record from for filling.

data-ln-fill-id.description: Item record ID to fill into target container.

element.note: Filter control container (commonly <ul> or <ol> with <li> checkbox options, <form>, <nav>, or <div> panel).

data-ln-filter.description: Initializes filter and sets target table/list ID.

data-ln-filter-key.description: Target payload field key for filtering.

data-ln-filter-hide.description: State attribute set by JS on filtered-out elements.

data-ln-filter-reset.description: Reset trigger button for filter values.

data-ln-filter-col.description: Maps column index or field name for table column filtering.

element.note: Standard HTML5 form element.

data-ln-form.description: Initializes form population and method spoofing.

data-ln-form-action-edit.description: URL path template for RESTful edit mode (e.g. '/admin/users/:id').

data-ln-form-action-method.description: HTTP method spoofing value placed in _method hidden field.

data-ln-form-scope.description: Opt-in local-first write routing scope matching a target ln-data-coordinator entity namespace.

element.note: Row or card element turned into a click-navigable surface by delegating clicks to its first inner <a> link.
Container for data-driven list rendering (<ul data-ln-list> or <ol data-ln-list>).

data-ln-list.description: Initializes list component and sets list ID.

data-ln-list-empty.description: Empty state container selector or message text.

data-ln-list-body.description: Marks internal container element for list item injection.

data-ln-list-source.description: Data store or resource name for list items.

data-ln-list-total.description: Target element to render total count.

data-ln-list-filtered.description: Target element to render filtered count.

data-ln-list-selected.description: Target element to render selected count.

data-ln-item-select.description: Selection checkbox inside list item template.

data-ln-item.description: Marks individual item element inside template.

data-ln-item-id.description: Rendered record ID on item root element.

data-ln-list-field.description: Field key mapping for list item binding.

data-ln-list-select-all.description: Global select-all checkbox for list items.

data-ln-list-window-page.description: Page fetch chunk size for list virtualization.

data-ln-list-window-threshold.description: Prefetch threshold in items for list virtualization.

data-ln-list-count.description: Grand total item count for virtualization.

element.note: JS invokes dom.showModal() and listens for native cancel events; must be <dialog>.

data-ln-modal.description: Modal state attribute written by JS to open or close the dialog.

data-ln-modal-close.description: Presence attribute on buttons/links inside modal to trigger close on click.

data-ln-modal-mode.description: Mode state set on dialog by coordinator ('new' vs 'edit').

data-ln-modal-when.description: Conditional display attribute on titles inside modal (controlled by SCSS based on modal-mode).

element.note: Layer 2 coordinator attached to dialog modal for form fill/reset.

data-ln-modal-coordinator.description: Activates modal coordinator for hash navigation and form fill.

data-ln-modal-for.description: Binds trigger button to target modal ID.

element.note: Navigation bar active link highlight container (<nav>, <ul>, or <ol>).

data-ln-nav.description: Initializes navigation link active state tracking.

data-ln-nav-exact.description: Requires exact URL path match for active link state.

element.note: Number formatting component for form <input> controls or inline display elements (<data>, <span>, <td>, <strong>).
Populates select or datalist option elements from data store.

data-ln-options.description: Data store name to fetch select option items from.

data-ln-options-value.description: Record field key to use for option value attribute.

data-ln-options-label.description: Record field key to use for option text label.

element.note: Positioned popover container element.

data-ln-popover-for.description: Target popover element ID bound to trigger button.

data-ln-popover-placement.description: Computed dynamic placement attribute set by positioning engine.

element.note: Linear progress bar container (<div data-ln-progress='50'>) whose width percentage and ARIA roles update dynamically.
Single Page Application client router and viewport outlet.

data-ln-route-target.description: Target outlet element ID for rendering route content.

data-ln-outlet.description: Marks viewport outlet element for swapped view content.

data-ln-route-keep.description: Preserves view state in DOM cache when unmounted.

data-ln-router-hydrate.description: Hydrates server-rendered initial markup without re-fetch.

data-ln-route-title.description: Document page title to set when route activates.

element.note: Search text input control.

data-ln-search.description: ID of target element/container to filter.

data-ln-search-hide.description: State attribute set by JS to hide non-matching items.

data-ln-search-items.description: CSS selector for target child items inside container (e.g. 'tbody tr').

data-ln-search-debounce.description: Debounce delay in ms (use 0 for instant local DOM filter, >=150 for API search).

data-ln-search-clear.description: Button trigger to clear search term input.

element.note: Applies strictly to <input> elements for slug generation; JS enforces dom.tagName === 'INPUT'.

data-ln-slug-from.description: Source input field name/id to convert into URL slug.

element.note: Sort control root <ul data-ln-sort="targetId">; three <li><button data-ln-sort-dir> triggers, only one visible at a time via CSS.

data-ln-sort.description: ID of the target element being sorted.

data-ln-sort-field.description: Record field name for data-driven sorting. Omit inside a <th> to fall back to th.cellIndex (SSR/DOM only) — never combine both on the same instance.

data-ln-sort-state.description: Current sort state on the root; drives which trigger <button> is visible via CSS.

data-ln-sort-items.description: CSS selector for target child items for default-DOM-behaviour reordering (mirrors data-ln-search-items).

data-ln-sort-dir.description: Identifies which sort action a trigger <button> performs.

data-ln-persist.description: Opt-in. Persists { field, column, direction } to localStorage, keyed per instance.

element.note: Drag-and-drop sortable list container (<ul data-ln-sortable> or <ol data-ln-sortable>).

data-ln-sortable.description: Enables drag-and-drop re-ordering on child items.

data-ln-sortable-handle.description: CSS selector for drag handle handle button. Applied to chile, sortable, elements.

element.note: Inline metric display bound to data store count.

data-ln-stat.description: Target store name to display live count for.

element.note: Data table wrapper container enclosing a <table> element.

data-ln-table.description: Initializes table component and sets unique table ID.

data-ln-table-source.description: Data store or resource name in Data-Driven mode.

data-ln-table-col.description: Maps <th> header column to record payload field key.

data-ln-table-col-filter.description: Column filter popover trigger button inside <th>.

data-ln-table-filter-col.description: Maps column header to filter key for column filtering.

data-ln-table-selectable.description: Enables row checkboxes and multi-selection mode.

data-ln-table-col-select.description: Marks <th> header column containing global select-all checkbox.

data-ln-table-row.description: Marks <tr> row element inside row template.

data-ln-table-row-id.description: Rendered record ID on row element.

data-ln-table-row-action.description: Action button trigger name inside row.

data-ln-table-window-page.description: Page fetch chunk size for server requests in windowed mode (default: 200).

data-ln-table-window-threshold.description: Prefetch margin threshold in rows before page boundaries (default: 25).

data-ln-table-count.description: Declares unfiltered grand total for windowed virtualization.

data-ln-table-total.description: Footer element to display total record count.

data-ln-table-filtered.description: Footer element to display filtered count.

data-ln-table-selected.description: Footer element to display selected count.

data-ln-table-empty.description: Empty state container selector or template.

data-ln-table-empty-when.description: Targets empty state variant based on search vs initial load.

data-ln-table-cell-attr.description: Field-to-attribute interpolation list for cell elements.

data-ln-table-dict.description: Selector for hidden i18n dictionary strings in table.

element.note: Layer 2 table coordinator binding table, search, filter, and clear triggers.

data-ln-table-clear-all.description: Button to clear all active search and column filters.

data-ln-table-clear.description: Button to clear specific table search term.

element.note: Tabbed interface container wrapper.

data-ln-tab.description: Tab button activator bound to target panel ID.

data-ln-tabs-default.description: Default active tab ID on load.

data-ln-tabs-active.description: State attribute reflecting active tab ID.

data-ln-tabs-for.description: SCSS selector binding tab button to panel.

element.note: Semantic <time datetime='...'> tag for localized time formatting.

data-ln-time.description: Time formatting style preset using Intl.DateTimeFormat.

data-ln-time-locale.description: Locale tag override for time rendering.

element.note: Sequential toast notification container list (<ol data-ln-toast> or <ul data-ln-toast>) rendering ordered toast <li> items.

data-ln-toast-item.description: Marks individual toast item element inside template.

data-ln-toast-max.description: Maximum number of simultaneous visible toast messages (default: 5).

data-ln-toast-close.description: Close button trigger inside toast item.

element.note: Toggle trigger control or collapsible target element (button, section, div, ul, li).

data-ln-toggle.description: Visibility state attribute written by JS ('open' or 'closed').

data-ln-toggle-for.description: Binds trigger element to target toggle panel ID.

element.note: Tooltip target host element.

data-ln-tooltip-enhance.description: Opt-in trigger to enhance custom tooltip elements.

data-ln-tooltip-placement.description: Computed placement attribute set by positioning engine.

data-ln-tooltip-enhanced.description: State attribute indicating JS positioning engine has activated.

element.note: Form translation manager container.

data-ln-translations.description: Initializes form field translation manager on a form or container.

data-ln-translations-default.description: Default language code (e.g. 'en') used to flag original (non-cloned) input elements.

data-ln-translations-locales.description: JSON string of available language locale configurations.

data-ln-translations-placeholder.description: Opt-in placeholder template for cloned inputs, e.g. '{lang} translation'.

data-ln-translations-remove-label.description: Opt-in aria-label template for the badge remove button, e.g. 'Remove {lang}'.

data-ln-translatable.description: Marks form field wrapper as translatable across active locales.

data-ln-translatable-lang.description: State tag set on cloned input elements for language code.

data-ln-translations-lang.description: Language code associated with template items like badges or menu buttons.

data-ln-translations-prefix.description: Nested object field prefix for cloned inputs (e.g. 'product').

element.note: File upload dropzone container.

data-ln-upload.description: Initializes file uploader and sets upload endpoint URL.

data-ln-upload-delete.description: URL endpoint pattern for file deletion requests.

data-ln-upload-accept.description: Comma-separated list of allowed file extensions (e.g. '.pdf,.png').

data-ln-upload-context.description: Context namespace identifier sent with upload FormData.

data-ln-upload-dict.description: Selector for hidden i18n message dictionary strings.

element.note: Input control field with HTML5 validity validation.

data-ln-validate-errors.description: Container element for validation error message list.

data-ln-validate-error.description: Error message item key matching HTML5 ValidityState property or custom backend error key.
